Claim: Leaked DHS/TSA memos showed the Trump administration was testing 'internal travel restrictions' inside the U.S. (checkpoints, boarding denials, dual-nationality stops).
Ended: July 7, 2025 (Snopes: false; White House: 'obviously fake news')
Who_Pushed_It: Viral Facebook reels / TikTok narration accounts
Notes: No media coverage of any such leaked memos; Snopes flagged likely AI narration/scripting.

Claim: President Trump posted on Truth Social that he was ending dual citizenship under the Espionage Act and would 'denaturalize and deport' 'traitors.'
Ended: April 4, 2025 (PolitiFact False: fabricated screenshot)
Who_Pushed_It: Viral Facebook posts with fake Truth Social screenshot
Notes: Lead Stories also found no matching post on Trump's account or archives.

Claim: A 2025 ICE photo showed agents arresting a man in a 'Latinos for Trump 2024' shirt (framed as Trump voters being swept up).
Ended: Jan 30, 2025 (PolitiFact False; Reuters Altered; USA Today Manipulated media)
Who_Pushed_It: Instagram/social posts; El Chigüire Bipolar among amplifiers
Notes: 2018 Fresh Mark (Ohio) raid photo; original shirt blank; vests read HSI not ICE.

Claim: Video showed Donald Trump announcing the U.S. would no longer give visas to Nigerians / limit visas for Nigerian professionals.
Ended: Jan 31, 2025 (PolitiFact False: altered audio; no such policy)
Who_Pushed_It: Facebook viral video posts
Notes: Audio mismatched mouth movements; source was Nov. 6, 2024 election-night remarks that did not mention Nigeria or visas.

Claim: Viral TikTok montage documented ICE removing undocumented foster children from foster homes for deportation.
Ended: July 8, 2025 (Lead Stories: unrelated prank/local-police/Inside Edition clips)
Who_Pushed_It: TikTok @newshr19 and viral shares
Notes: Opening clip was a humor toddler-'arrest' prank; other clips lacked ICE insignia.

Claim: Viral video showed ICE mass-arresting/deporting Walmart store staff.
Ended: Oct 29, 2025 (Lead Stories: AI-generated; headless officer artifacts)
Who_Pushed_It: TikTok viral posts
Notes: AI glitches included a headless ICE officer and tape passing through a body.

Claim: President Trump posted on Truth Social calling for cellphone camera 'kill switches' so ICE (and 'my SS') could stop filming of agents, with noncompliance a felony.
Ended: Jan 26, 2026 (Lead Stories: satire/fake; no such Truth Social post)
Who_Pushed_It: 'Gavin Newsom for President 2028' Facebook Group and viral shares
Notes: Satirical tells included 'my SS' and 'proud ICE boys' language.

Claim: President Trump asked via Truth Social that ICE detention centers also be used to lock up 'communists' (including Democrat politicians).
Ended: July 8, 2026 (Lead Stories: fake screenshot)
Who_Pushed_It: Viral X posts with fabricated Truth Social image
Notes: Fake post also mocked people 'demanding affordable childcare' / 'giving everyone healthcare.'

Claim: President Trump posted on Truth Social after a Minneapolis ICE-related shooting that 'only criminals carry guns on our streets.'
Ended: Jan 26, 2026 (PolitiFact Pants on Fire; NRA fake-news alert)
Who_Pushed_It: X, Facebook, and Threads users
Approximate_Duration: 1–2 days until PolitiFact Pants on Fire
Notes: Archives showed no such post; Trump's real post concerned the gunman's weapon.

Claim: President Trump posted on Truth Social that after annexing Greenland as the 52nd state he would 'annexe Alaska' as the 53rd.
Ended: March 19, 2025 (PolitiFact False: fabricated; Alaska already a state since 1959)
Who_Pushed_It: Threads, Facebook, and X users
Notes: Falsely portrays Trump as not knowing Alaska is already a U.S. state.

Claim: Elon Musk posted on X that DOGE found 'tens of millions of dollars spent on golf by a single government official' (implying Trump).
Ended: April 4, 2025 (PolitiFact False: fabricated; UI still said 'Retweets')
Who_Pushed_It: Viral Facebook posts
Notes: Echoed Guardian golf-cost reporting but was not an authentic Musk post.

Claim: Rep. Eric Swalwell: 'No president has had more planes crash in their first month in office than Donald Trump.'
Ended: Feb 24, 2025 (PolitiFact: NTSB data show Biden/Obama first months had more aviation accidents)
Who_Pushed_It: Rep. Eric Swalwell (D-CA); related viral Threads crash-spike posts
Notes: Swalwell later narrowed to two major commercial crashes; original absolute wording contradicted by NTSB (48 Trump vs 61 Biden first-month accidents). Fox/DOT figures similarly undercut the claim.

Claim: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth requested more than $137,000 in upgrades to his Fort McNair military residence.
Began: Around Jan 30, 2025 (Army notice to Congress; Democratic criticism)
Ended: AP: Hegseth did not request the work; Army initiated repairs on a vacant century-old home
Who_Pushed_It: Democratic lawmakers including Reps. Debbie Wasserman Schultz and Rosa DeLauro; media coverage of the cost figure
Approximate_Duration: Days from notice until AP clarification
Notes: AP: official familiar with the work order said Hegseth did not request upgrades; ~$50k was paint.

Claim: New VA hospital guidelines under Trump allowed doctors to refuse to treat unmarried veterans and Democrats.
Ended: June 18, 2025 (Guardian amended after VA called story false and cited continuing federal protections)
Who_Pushed_It: The Guardian (Aaron Glantz); VoteVets and social amplifiers of original framing
Notes: VA Secretary Doug Collins called original story false; updated Guardian headline focused on bylaw language removals while noting federal law still bars refusal of care.

Claim: Authentic photo showed an ICE agent grabbing/dragging a crying Latino child from a school classroom ('This is what conservatives voted for').
Ended: Jan 28–Feb 18, 2025 (Snopes/Reuters/Lead Stories: AI via Grok; creator confirmed)
Who_Pushed_It: X @LiveOnTheChat (creator) then viral Facebook/Instagram/Threads shares as real
Approximate_Duration: ~4 days to Snopes; ~3 weeks to Reuters
Notes: Grok prompt: generate ICE agents aggressively dragging Latino children crying out of a 2nd-grade classroom.

Claim: Video showed NYPD officers arresting ICE agents in New York ('Bye bye ICE!').
Ended: Nov 24, 2025 (AFP: AI-generated)
Who_Pushed_It: Threads/X/Instagram/TikTok/Facebook celebratory posts; FunnelStreams.AI-linked origin
Notes: Uniform and door/trunk AI inconsistencies; Hive high AI probability.

Claim: Video showed workers fleeing an ICE/'migración' workplace raid in January 2025 after Trump's inauguration.
Ended: Jan 22, 2025 (Lead Stories: Tysons, VA footage predates Sept 2024 Google imagery)
Who_Pushed_It: TikTok Spanish-captioned posts ('LES CAYÓ MIGRACIÓN')
Notes: Building under construction in video was already finished in Sept 2024 Street View.

Claim: DOGE forwarded names of ~156–163 members of Congress (mostly Democrats) to the IRS for 'immediate audit.'
Ended: Feb 21, 2025 (USA Today False: stolen satire; watermark cropped)
Who_Pushed_It: Viral Facebook/X/Instagram posts
Notes: Originated on America's Last Line of Defense satire network.

Claim: Elon Musk posted on X that anyone protesting the Trump administration would be suspended from X.
Ended: Feb 5, 2025 (USA Today Manipulated media: fabricated)
Who_Pushed_It: Threads/Facebook/Instagram viral posts
Notes: No record on Musk's X account; identical crops indicated single fabricated source.

Claim: Video showed an ICE agent entering a Cal State University San Bernardino classroom looking for a student.
Ended: Jan 21, 2026 (Lead Stories: Sora AI watermark; no news of such raid)
Who_Pushed_It: TikTok @eye.eat.ai and viral shares
Notes: OpenAI Sora watermark visible in frame.

Claim: Video authentically showed ICE agents arresting and deporting Pizza Hut employees.
Ended: Nov 13, 2025 (Snopes Fake: AI-generated)
Who_Pushed_It: Facebook USA Journey 897 and viral Instagram/Facebook shares
Notes: Page later added an AI disclaimer after virality; dialogue role-swaps and disappearing agent.

Claim: Trump passed a new law so that whoever pays child support gets to declare the children on their taxes.
Ended: Jan 21, 2025 (PolitiFact False: no such law; IRS rules unchanged)
Who_Pushed_It: TikTok / Instagram / Facebook posts
Notes: Claim circulated before inauguration; no Trump X announcement.

Claim: President Trump 'made 4,725 wire transfers' to Jeffrey Epstein totaling nearly $1.1 billion.
Ended: Aug 5, 2025 (PolitiFact False: misrepresented Sen. Ron Wyden's Epstein-account remarks)
Who_Pushed_It: Facebook reels and X posts with misleading captions over Wyden clip
Notes: Wyden described wires in/out of one Epstein account; Finance Committee said reviewed docs did not mention Trump.

Claim: President Trump signed an executive order ending food stamps and cash assistance.
Ended: Jan 28, 2025 (Snopes: False; no such EO)
Who_Pushed_It: TikTok @krystalsohipapate; X amplifiers
Notes: Distinct from later legislative SNAP debates; specific EO-abolition claim was false.

Claim: Trump signed an executive order giving public-housing residents a two-year deadline (effective 2026) to leave.
Ended: Feb 12–14, 2025 (Lead Stories / USA Today False: no such EO)
Who_Pushed_It: Instagram / Facebook viral posts
Approximate_Duration: ~1 week until USA Today / Lead Stories
Notes: White House/HUD sites had no such order; first-day housing EO did not set public-housing time limits.

Claim: ICE is offering a $750 reward for reporting 'illegal immigrants' via its tip line under Trump's mass-deportation push.
Ended: Jan 24, 2025 (USA Today False: ICE does not offer rewards for civil immigration tips)
Who_Pushed_It: Instagram / Facebook / X posts
Notes: ICE: tip line exists for criminal activity but no rewards for civil immigration enforcement tips.

Claim: Videos showed dozens of migrants/children sleeping on the floor of an ICE facility as proof of Trump-era 'disgrace' detention conditions.
Ended: Dec 1, 2025 (AFP: likely AI-generated; three forensics experts)
Who_Pushed_It: X / Instagram / Threads posts; TikTok @multiversoviral1 origin
Notes: Experts cited AI statistical traces, flickering blanket reflections, deformed fingers/faces; Sora-related account pattern.

Claim: Video showed Ethiopian opposition politicians Gedu Andargachew and Lidetu Ayalew being forcibly deported from the U.S. under Trump TPS/enforcement moves.
Ended: Dec 19, 2025 (AFP: AI-generated; no news of such deportations)
Who_Pushed_It: Facebook posts in Amharic and English
Notes: AI anomalies included self-rolling luggage and mismatched faces; Ethiopian TPS end was announced but effective Feb 2026, and no reports of these figures' deportation.

Claim: Video of an ICE agent deporting his own mother ('Sorry Mom, this is my job') was authentic San Bernardino enforcement footage.
Ended: Oct 23, 2025 (Lead Stories: AI-generated parody)
Who_Pushed_It: TikTok @crusty.left.sock (labeled AI parody) and downstream shares treating it as real
Notes: Scrambled vest symbols; original caption admitted AI parody.

Claim: ABC News footage 'appeared to show' Turkish military bombing Kurdish civilians in Syria amid criticism of Trump's Syria withdrawal (it was Knob Creek, Kentucky gun-range video).
Ended: Oct 14–15, 2019 (ABC took down video; 'ABC News regrets the error')

Notes: Aired during Turkey's offensive after Trump's Syria pullback; Snopes also documented ABC's regret statement.
